g.text: All buttons are wired as active low, consistent with micro:bit buttons A and B. If using hardware directly, user will need to enable pull up resistors on corresponding hardware pins.
Additional pokehome connectors for button A & B signals

2.2K series resistors on signal lines to prevent excess current draw if micro:bit pins are congifured as outputs, written to a logic high state, and the buttons are pressed. This also means that logic "low" will be in the neighborhood of 0.5 V. The nordic IC claims logic low threshold of 0.3 x Vcc, approx 1V for 3.3V supply.
